tasks.label: boot-emulator
tasks.detail: Sobe um emulador Android só se nenhum estiver conectado (multiplataforma).

args: EMU="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}/emulator/emulator"; if ! adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-'; then nohup "$EMU" -avd "$("$EMU" -list-avds | head -1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 &! ; fi
EMU="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}/emulator/emulator"; if ! adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-'; then nohup "$EMU" -avd "$("$EMU" -list-avds | head -1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 & disown; fi

tasks.detail: Inicia o Metro e abre o app no emulador Android (dev build).
